messages:
jane-cs: FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — their rerank endpoint is returning weird negative scores and sometimes extremely large-magnitude negatives after a burst of 401s this morning. They expect probabilities.
jane-cs: sample they sent: `scores: [-12.3, -5.2, -999999.0]` and later `scores: [0.12, 0.05, -0.9]` after retrying. They also saw a 401 in the logs, then a 200 with different magnitudes. Ticket #CS-4721
Tom-eng: thanks, staring into it. can you drop the full request payload (sanitized) and any headers they used? specifically Authorization header shape and model param.
jane-cs: pasted sanitized payload:

```
POST /v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>
{
  "model": "rerank-latest",
  "query": "how do I reset my password",
  "documents": ["doc1 text...","doc2 text...","doc3 text..."],
  "return_raw_scores": true
}
```

Also included logs: `2026-03-15T08:12:03Z 401 Authorization failed`, then `2026-03-15T08:12:05Z 200` with scores above.
alex-ml: quick hypothesis: the client hit an auth rotation which caused a short fallback to a legacy routing path (model alias `rerank-latest` briefly pointed at an old variant with a different score head). legacy rerank variants return unnormalized logits; newer variants expose a `score_mode` flag. Negative logits are expected. If customer expected probabilities, they need softmax/normalization or set `score_mode": "probability"` (if available).
maria-sre: ops note — deploy-bot shows a config push around 08:11 that updated an alias mapping. deploy-bot: `deploy 2026-03-15T08:11:59Z alias rerank-latest -> reranker-v2` then rollback at 08:12:04Z. that timing matches the 401/200 window.
Tom-eng: okay that explains the magnitude flip. action items:
1) jane: ask customer to pin to `model: reranker-v2` (explicit version) while we investigate alias instability.
2) alex: can you confirm whether legacy variant returned sentinel values (-999999) for out-of-range scores or if that's a client-side artifact? also confirm whether our client SDKs mention normalization.

alex-ml: checked historical responses from the legacy variant — it did emit large negative sentinel logits for empty contexts in some tokenization mismatch cases. the -999999 appears on our side (not client postprocessing). I'll open a repro job and attach exact model outputs.

jane-cs: customer asked for a mitigation now — can we give them a quick snippet to convert logits to probabilities on their side?

Tom-eng: yes — small Python snippet they can run locally:
```
import math
logits = [-12.3, -5.2, -1.1]
exp = [math.exp(x) for x in logits]
sum_exp = sum(exp)
probs = [e / sum_exp for e in exp]
print(probs)
```
Note: large negative logits will underflow exp to 0; you may want to subtract max(logits) for numerical stability.

alex-ml: adding numerically-stable version they can use:
```
import math
logits = [-12.3, -5.2, -999999.0]
m = max(logits)
exp = [math.exp(x - m) for x in logits]
sum_exp = sum(exp)
probs = [e / sum_exp for e in exp]
print(probs)
```
This will push sentinel entries to ~0 but preserve relative probabilities.

maria-sre: ops next steps — pin alias to stable target, double-check the alias rollout automation to avoid brief dangling states during key rotation. I've created infra ticket INFRA-2156 and set it P1 for the rollback behavior.

Tom-eng: I'll follow up with a small doc patch in rerank docs to call out that `rerank` returns raw logits by default and that clients expecting probabilities should either request `score_mode=probability` (if supported) or run softmax client-side. Also adding note about alias rollouts.

jane-cs: customer update: we've asked them to pin to `reranker-v2` and to run the Python snippet. They're happy to test and will confirm in the ticket. I'll keep this thread updated.

alex-ml: repro job started — attaching logs to CS ticket when ready. initial check shows alias timing + token rotation explains the 401 then inconsistent outputs.

maria-sre: deploy-bot: `rollback completed 2026-03-15T08:12:04Z` — keeping watch for further flapping.

Tom-eng: summary for notes: cause = alias/rollout timing + legacy model variant with unnormalized logits; symptom = negative and sentinel scores; mitigation = pin explicit model version or normalize logits; long-term = add alias rollout safety checks and doc clarifications. I'll draft follow-up PR and link it here.

jane-cs: thanks everyone, I'll close the immediate P1 once Acme confirms and will re-open if they still see anomalies.
